 $14 at lululemon.com See 2 more I'm training for my longest race yet this spring, and I have a few things on my wishlist before the big day. One pick I'm eyeing is a Lululemon belt bag or running belt—I need something that can hold my energy gels, electrolytes, phone, and keys while leaving extra room for my sunglasses or earbuds when I don't feel like wearing them.
 Luckily, Lululemon just kicked off its early Black Friday sale on November 18 at 11 p.m. ET. You can already save up to 50% on the brand's ever-popular belt bags, which are still going strong in 2026 thanks to their cute looks and everyday practicality. Just note that select colors of each bag are on sale. Hint: some colors of the OG are just $19, but styles are selling fast!

 Save $44 at LULULEMON Our pros at the Good Housekeeping Institute have been fans of the Lululemon Belt Bag for years. Emma Seymour , associate director of the Textiles Lab, wrote in her review: "It's been my travel buddy on multiple trips, keeping my wallet and cash secure without adding extra weight, thanks to its lightweight fabric. I like that this bag is roomier than other fanny packs I've tried without being too bulky. It fits my phone, wallet, keys, hand sanitizer, and Kindle. It's one of the most affordable buys at Lululemon too."
 Now there are several iterations of the OG belt bag since it first came out: some larger, some smaller, ones with more zippered pockets, and others with top handles instead of crossbody straps. All of the above are included in the sale.
 I'm personally interested in its Fast and Free Running Belt , which I got for my sister two Christmases ago. I like that it's more discreet and sits securely on your waist, plus it comes in several dreamy colors. You can get it in sizes XS/S, S/M, and L/XL.
 Advertisement Advertisement Lululemon rarely holds sales, so as a shopping editor, I heavily recommend jumping on this one. We don't know how long it'll last!
